description: This Java class, ObservableMdcAdapter, acts as a wrapper around BasicMDCAdapter to add observer functionality for testing purposes. It allows registration of observers that get notified on MDC operations such as put, get, remove, and clear, facilitating observability during unit testing.

classes.name: ObservableMdcAdapter
classes.description: A thread-unsafe MDC adapter that delegates MDC calls to a BasicMDCAdapter and notifies registered observers for each operation.

classes.name: MdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: Interface for observers that get notified on MDC operations within ObservableMdcAdapter.

classes.name: AbstractMdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: An abstract default implementation of MdcAdapterObserver with no-op methods, allowing subclasses to override only necessary methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ObservableMdcAdapter.

methods.name: registerObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer with a given name.

methods.name: deregisterObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the registration.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Delegates to BasicMDCAdapter and notifies observers about the put operation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Delegates to BasicMDCAdapter and notifies observers about the get operation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Delegates to BasicMDCAdapter and notifies observers about the remove operation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears MDC context and notifies observers.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of MDC keys and notifies observers.

methods.name: getCopyOfContextMap
methods.description: Returns a copy of the MDC context map and notifies observers.

methods.name: setContextMap
methods.description: Sets the MDC context map and notifies observers.

methods.name: notifyAllObservers
methods.description: Internal method to notify all registered observers about a specific MDC operation.
